Quest Stop 1

The planner & its digital companion

The core guide: a pocket-sized paperback for Daily Quests, resets, brain dumps and affirmations, plus a fillable digital companion so writing space never runs out.

2nd Edition

ADHD Pocket Quest

A Daily Guide for Wonderfully Wired Brains — by Phelicia Noggle-O’Brien

Pocket-sized, quest-shaped, and built to travel — for backpacks, bedside tables, and everywhere in between.

What’s inside the world

  • Daily Quest pages — Must-Do, Quick Wins, Brain Boost, XP Earned
  • Priority matrices for gentle days, hyperfocus days, and everything between
  • Soft, Cozy, and Panic resets — because a reset isn’t a failure
  • A 45-page fillable Digital Companion so the writing space never runs out

Posters, dice & more

A growing line of reset-and-recovery posters, plus a fold-your-own dice — the same no-shame philosophy as the planner, reshaped for different rooms. All fully designed already; the hold-up is finding a print-on-demand setup that doesn’t need a big upfront spend.
